senses.definition: The outer side of a window or door frame.
senses.example: The building has a one-story rusticated limestone base and a canopied entrance with a doorman beneath an attractive, rusticated limestone window reveal on the second floor and a very impressive and ornate limestone window reveal on the third floor flanked by female figureshttps://www.cityrealty.com/nyc/carnegie-hill/1105-park-avenue/review/7216.

senses.definition: A revelation; an uncovering of what was hidden in the scene or story.
senses.example: The comedian had been telling us about his sleep being disturbed by noise. Then came the reveal: he was sleeping on a bed in a department store.

senses.definition: To uncover; to show and display that which was hidden or unknown.
senses.example:
c. 1625, Edmund Waller, Of the Danger His Majesty (being Prince) Escaped in the Road at St Andero
Light was the wound, the prince's care unknown, / She might not, would not, yet reveal her own.

senses.definition: To communicate that which could not be known or discovered without divine or supernatural instruction.
synonyms: let the cat out of the bag
